scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Oct 7 after-dusk navigation practice usable by meeting its personal visibility-light requirement before the gear manifest closes.
Emerging Need: The session becomes night-water activity only after approval; stored gear-care details are needed to know the personal set lacks a white stern clip.
Decision Context: Club loaners are unavailable until the charger audit clears, then the hold thread briefly accepts item-specific member-ID entries before export.
Consequence: If the manifest closes without a stern clip assigned, the practice remains scheduled but the required light cannot be added through club loaners.

parameter.title: Rainwake after-dusk navigation practice
parameter.description: Tentative Lake Union navigation practice; after-dark format pending harbor approval, with gear requirements to follow.

parameter.subject: Oct 7 navigation practice remains daylight-contingent
parameter.body: Harbor approval for the Oct 7 navigation practice is still pending. Please do not request night-light loaners yet; the gear table will wait for the final go/no-go before opening any holds.

parameter.subject: Oct 7 navigation practice approved for after-dusk format
parameter.body: Approval came through for the Oct 7 after-dusk format. Everyone on the practice roster must arrive with a working red/green bow clip and white stern clip light, either personal or assigned club loaner, recorded on the Oct 5 noon manifest. Loaner count will be posted after the charger audit; requests before the audit cannot be accepted.

parameter.content: Oct night gear hold sheet is now live in this thread: remaining club white stern clip lights, 8. Entries close Thu Oct 1 at 17:00; each entry must list the item needed and Rainwake member ID. Holds can be released until Oct 4.

parameter.subject: Oct 7 night-light manifest exported
parameter.body: The Oct 7 night-light loaner manifest was exported at 17:00. The gear desk will not add additional white stern clips for this practice; unassigned paddlers need personal complete light sets at check-in.
